day_line: A great tree on a Tiger day. Tall and brave: good for outdoor plans and fresh starts, easy to rush.

lines.Yang Wood: Your crew is up for it today. Walk the park connector together, brunch at the end.
lines.Yin Wood: A sibling wants the same plan today. Flip a coin and laugh about it.
lines.Yang Fire: A quiet Sunday idea grows today. Write it on paper, not in your phone.
lines.Yin Fire: You're looked after today. Let someone else plan the day for once.
lines.Yang Earth: Sunday fills up fast. Protect one hour that's only for you.
lines.Yin Earth: Your care gets noticed today. Someone says thank you; believe them.
lines.Yang Metal: A fresh chance appears today. Sign up for the class you keep saving.
lines.Yin Metal: Gift season starts today. Plan the Christmas presents and set one budget.
lines.Yang Water: Play comes easily today. Try the new trail or the new dessert, or both.
lines.Yin Water: Your words carry warmth today. Send a voice note to a friend overseas.

group_tips.clash: Go easy today. Skip the debate and keep plans light.
group_tips.friction: Small snags today. Let one remark slide and move on.
group_tips.steady: A calm, normal Sunday. One chore, then a slow walk.
group_tips.best: Your day to shine. Plan the outing and lead the way.

caption:
Born in a Monkey year? Today is a Tiger day, so go easy. Drop your animal below 👇

Every day has an animal, and it meets the animal of the year you were born. Tiger and Monkey sit opposite, so today asks Monkey people for patience; Horse, Dog and Pig get along with the Tiger and have an easy day; Snake feels a little friction. Born in January or early February? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. Your element is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Which group are you in today? Comment your animal.
